Namaz Dua.Title: Astaghfirullah
Namaz Dua.Translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah

Namaz Dua.Title: Short durood
Namaz Dua.Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad

Namaz Dua.Title: Reflecting on peace
Namaz Dua.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
Namaz Dua.Translation: O Allah, You are Peace, and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
Namaz Dua.Transliteration: Allahumma anta as-salaamu wa minka as-salaam, tabaarakta yaa dhal-jalaali wal-ikraam

Namaz Dua.Title: Subhanallah
Namaz Dua.Translation: Glory be to Allah

Namaz Dua.Title: Alhamdulilah
Namaz Dua.Translation: All praise is due to Allah

Namaz Dua.Title: Allahu Akbar
Namaz Dua.Translation: Allah is the greatest

Namaz Dua.Title: Purification of tongue and heart
Namaz Dua.Translation: Glory is to Allah and all praise is to Him

Namaz Dua.Title: Remembrance
Namaz Dua.Arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
Namaz Dua.Translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, and He has no partner
Namaz Dua.Transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah
